failure_paths: Normal/invalid/missing/non-regular/out-of-scope reads, output/memory budget refusal, cancellation during and between reads, repeated version conflict, and allocation failure at each allocation point execute in the batch suite. Fault hooks are unconditional in these tests; the explicit fault-enabled build also passes.
limits_and_remaining_gates: Deadline plumbing remains inherited and deferred to the next cross-cutting task: ReadSpec.deadline_ms is carried but T04 does not enforce it, and I06 has no explicit cancellation/deadline parameter. This repair only prevents grouping unequal deadline values; no public API changed.

Unequal ranges and output caps no longer coalesce, so some requests perform more reads. The existing 32-item fixture uses 28 jobs instead of 25, retains one exact duplicate, and stays within the same memory/output/concurrency caps.
